sources.title: ElevenLabs: $22 million earned by voice creators (May 2026)

beats.say: [$22,000,000|Twenty-two million dollars], paid to voice creators. Here's the source.
Is creator money real, or just screenshots? Here are three numbers from the companies themselves.
One: ElevenLabs says it has paid over twenty-two million dollars to more than ten thousand four hundred voice creators.
Two: beehiiv's case study shows a newsletter earning twenty-five thousand dollars from Boosts.
Three: YouTube says over one point three million creators are in its Shopping affiliate program.
These are totals across many creators, so they show the stream is real, not what one person will make.
The catch: most creators earn far less than the top ones, so start small and track your own numbers.
